purpose: Convert a public tool/provider/schema complaint into a sanitized maintainer-ready repro pack.
sanitization_rules: drop secrets, API keys, tokens, private prompts, customer data
replace local paths with $WORKSPACE unless path itself is the bug
keep exact error strings and tool names
hash large logs and include excerpt only
acceptance_gates: expected contract names a concrete tool/schema boundary
